title: Matthew Chapter 18 Quiz - Multi-Level
description: An enhanced quiz on Matthew chapter 18 with Easy, Medium, Hard, and Theological levels. Each level has 15 carefully crafted questions. Choose your difficulty and dive in!

easy.title: Matthew Chapter 18 Quiz - Easy Level
easy.description: Perfect for beginners! Test your basic knowledge of Matthew Chapter 18.

questions.question: In Matthew 18, which of the following appears FIRST in the chapter?
options: Disciples asking who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven
Jesus calling a little child unto him
Jesus saying to become as little children
questions.correctAnswer: Disciples asking who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:1 records the disciples asking Jesus who is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven, which is the first event in this chapter.

questions.question: Who did Jesus call unto him and set in the midst of the disciples?
questions.correctAnswer: A little child
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:2 states that Jesus called a little child unto him and set him in the midst of them.

questions.question: According to Jesus in Matthew 18, what must one become to enter the kingdom of heaven?
options: Converted and become as little children
questions.correctAnswer: Converted and become as little children
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:3 says that except one be converted and become as little children, they shall not enter the kingdom of heaven.

questions.question: Who is considered the greatest in the kingdom of heaven according to Matthew 18?
options: Whosoever humbles himself as a little child
questions.correctAnswer: Whosoever humbles himself as a little child
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:4 states that whosoever shall humble himself as this little child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.

questions.question: What happens to one who receives a little child in Jesus' name?
questions.correctAnswer: Receiveth Jesus
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:5 indicates that whoso shall receive one such little child in Jesus' name receiveth Him.

questions.question: What is said about one who offends one of the little ones who believe in Jesus?
options: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck and drowned
He will become a great leader
questions.correctAnswer: It were better for him that a millstone were hanged about his neck and drowned
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:6 says it were better for such a person to have a millstone hung about his neck and be drowned in the sea.

questions.question: What does Jesus say must needs be in the world according to Matthew 18?
questions.correctAnswer: Offences must come
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:7 states that it must needs be that offences come, but woe to the man by whom the offence cometh.

questions.question: What does Jesus command if thy hand or thy foot offend thee?
options: Cut them off and cast them from thee
questions.correctAnswer: Cut them off and cast them from thee
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:8 commands that if thy hand or foot offend thee, cut them off and cast them from thee.

questions.question: According to Matthew 18, what should one do if their eye offends them?
options: Pluck it out and cast it from thee
questions.correctAnswer: Pluck it out and cast it from thee
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:9 says if thine eye offend thee, pluck it out and cast it from thee.

questions.question: Why should you take heed not to despise one of these little ones?
options: Because their angels always behold the face of my Father in heaven
Because they are stronger than you
questions.correctAnswer: Because their angels always behold the face of my Father in heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:10 states that their angels always behold the face of the Father in heaven.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the Son of man coming, according to Matthew 18?
options: To save that which was lost
questions.correctAnswer: To save that which was lost
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:11 clearly states that the Son of man came to save that which was lost.

questions.question: The man in the parable has an hundred sheep.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:12 says the man had an hundred sheep.

questions.question: The man leaves the ninety and nine sheep and goes to seek the one which was gone astray.
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:12 describes the man leaving the ninety and nine sheep to seek the one that was lost.

questions.question: Jesus commands believers to give money to the poor in Matthew 18.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: There is no command about giving money to the poor in Matthew 18.

questions.question: Matthew 18 instructs to pray three times a day for forgiveness.
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 18 does not mention praying three times a day or asking for forgiveness in this manner.

medium.title: Matthew Chapter 18 Quiz - Medium Level
medium.description: Ready for more? Apply biblical truths from Matthew Chapter 18 to real-life situations.

questions.question: What does Jesus say he rejoices more over in Matthew 18:13?
questions.correctAnswer: One lost sheep
questions.explanation: Jesus rejoices more over one lost sheep than over the ninety-nine that went not astray (Matthew 18:13).

questions.question: What does Matthew 18:14 state about the will of the Father concerning little ones?
options: One of these little ones should perish
questions.correctAnswer: One of these little ones should perish
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:14 emphasizes that it is not the Father's will that any of these little ones should perish.

questions.question: What should you do if your brother trespasses against you according to Matthew 18:15?
questions.correctAnswer: Tell him his fault privately
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:15 instructs that if your brother trespasses against you, you should tell him his fault between you and him alone.

questions.question: According to Matthew 18:16, what should you do if your brother does not listen to you?
options: Take one or two more witnesses
questions.correctAnswer: Take one or two more witnesses
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:16 says that if your brother does not listen, you should take one or two more witnesses to establish every word.

questions.question: What does Matthew 18:17 instruct if a brother neglects to hear the church?
options: He should be treated as a heathen
questions.correctAnswer: He should be treated as a heathen
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:17 states that if he neglects to hear the church, he should be treated as a heathen man and a publican.

questions.question: What authority is given in Matthew 18:18 regarding binding and loosing?
options: It will be done on earth only
It shall be bound and loosed in heaven
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be bound and loosed in heaven
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:18 affirms that whatsoever you bind on earth shall be bound in heaven, and whatsoever you loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven.

questions.question: What happens when two agree on earth according to Matthew 18:19?
options: It shall be done for them by the Father
questions.correctAnswer: It shall be done for them by the Father
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:19 states that if two agree on earth concerning anything they ask, it shall be done for them of the Father in heaven.

questions.question: What is promised in Matthew 18:20 when two or three are gathered in Jesus' name?
options: He is in the midst of them
questions.correctAnswer: He is in the midst of them
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:20 promises that where two or three are gathered in His name, there Jesus is in the midst of them.

questions.question: How many times did Peter initially think he should forgive his brother according to Matthew 18:21?
questions.correctAnswer: Seven times
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:21 shows Peter asking Jesus if he should forgive his brother up to seven times.

questions.question: What did Jesus say about forgiveness in Matthew 18:22?
questions.correctAnswer: Forgive seventy times seven
questions.explanation: In Matthew 18:22, Jesus tells Peter that he should forgive not just seven times, but seventy times seven.

questions.question: What parable is introduced in Matthew 18:23?
options: The parable of the lost sheep
The parable of the good Samaritan
The parable of the unforgiving servant
questions.correctAnswer: The parable of the unforgiving servant
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:23 states that the kingdom of heaven is likened unto a certain king who took account of his servants, leading to the parable of the unforgiving servant.

questions.question: What was the debt owed by the servant brought before the king in Matthew 18:24?
questions.correctAnswer: Ten thousand talents
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:24 specifies that the servant brought before the king owed him ten thousand talents.

questions.question: Is it true that it is better for one to enter life maimed than to be cast into fire according to Matthew 18:8?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:8 indicates that it is better to enter life halt or maimed than to be cast into everlasting fire.

questions.question: Is it false that woe is pronounced on the world because of offences in Matthew 18:7?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:7 states that woe unto the world because of offences, indicating that it is indeed true.

questions.question: Is it false that Jesus came to save that which was lost according to Matthew 18:11?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:11 clearly states that the Son of man came to save that which was lost, making this statement false.

hard.title: Matthew Chapter 18 Quiz - Hard Level
hard.description: Challenge yourself with deep analysis and cross-biblical connections from Matthew Chapter 18.

questions.question: What did the lord command to be done to the servant who could not pay his debt?
options: He was to be set free
He was to be sold along with his family
He was to be given more time
He was to be punished with a fine
questions.correctAnswer: He was to be sold along with his family
questions.explanation: The lord commanded him to be sold, and his wife, and children, and all that he had, and payment to be made. (Matthew 18:25)

questions.question: What did the servant ask from his lord when he fell down before him?
questions.correctAnswer: To have patience with him
questions.explanation: The servant worshipped him, saying, Lord, have patience with me, and I will pay thee all. (Matthew 18:26)

questions.question: What was the lord's reaction to the servant's plea?
options: He was moved with compassion and forgave him
questions.correctAnswer: He was moved with compassion and forgave him
questions.explanation: The lord of that servant was moved with compassion, and loosed him, and forgave him the debt. (Matthew 18:27)

questions.question: What did the servant do after being forgiven his debt?
options: He found a fellow servant and demanded payment
He went home to his family
questions.correctAnswer: He found a fellow servant and demanded payment
questions.explanation: The same servant went out, and found one of his fellowservants, which owed him an hundred pence: and he laid hands on him, and took him by the throat, saying, Pay me that thou owest. (Matthew 18:28)

questions.question: What consequence did the unforgiving servant face?
options: He was thrown into prison until his debt was paid
He was given a second chance
questions.correctAnswer: He was thrown into prison until his debt was paid
questions.explanation: He would not: but went and cast him into prison, till he should pay the debt. (Matthew 18:30)

questions.question: What did the lord say to the unforgiving servant when he called him back?
options: O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt
questions.correctAnswer: O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt
questions.explanation: His lord, after that he had called him, said unto him, O thou wicked servant, I forgave thee all that debt, because thou desiredst me. (Matthew 18:32)

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'sympatheia' in Matthew 18:27 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: Compassion
questions.explanation: 'Sympatheia' translates to compassion, as the lord was moved with compassion for the servant's plight. (Matthew 18:27)

questions.question: Which literary technique is used in the parable of the unforgiving servant?
questions.correctAnswer: Chiasmus
questions.explanation: The structure of the parable reflects a chiasmic pattern where the actions of the servant mirror each other, emphasizing the moral lesson of forgiveness.

questions.question: Which passage reflects the theme of forgiveness found in Matthew 18:35?
questions.correctAnswer: Ephesians 4:32
questions.explanation: Ephesians 4:32 encourages believers to be kind and forgiving, paralleling the lesson in Matthew 18:35 about forgiving others from the heart.

questions.question: Which verse precedes Matthew 18:26?
questions.correctAnswer: Matthew 18:25
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:25 is the verse that directly precedes Matthew 18:26, setting the context for the servant's plea.

questions.question: What does the word 'trespasses' in Matthew 18:35 imply?
questions.correctAnswer: Sins
questions.explanation: 'Trespasses' refers to sins or wrongdoings against others, which is the basis for forgiveness as discussed in Matthew 18:35.

questions.question: What does the Greek word 'aphiemi' in Matthew 18:27 mean?
questions.correctAnswer: To forgive
questions.explanation: 'Aphiemi' means to forgive or let go, which is the action taken by the lord in Matthew 18:27.

questions.question: Jesus taught that the greatest in the kingdom of heaven must be like which group?
questions.correctAnswer: Little children
questions.explanation: Jesus said, Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven. (Matthew 18:3)

questions.question: Is it true that the consequences of unforgiveness are severe according to Matthew 18:34?
questions.correctAnswer: True
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:34 shows that the lord was wroth and delivered the unforgiving servant to tormentors, indicating severe consequences for unforgiveness.

questions.question: Is it false that forgiveness should only be given in limited circumstances according to Matthew 18:35?
questions.correctAnswer: False
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:35 teaches that one must forgive from the heart, implying forgiveness is not limited, but must be genuine and complete.

theological.title: Matthew Chapter 18 Quiz - Theological Level
theological.description: Deep biblical theology from Matthew Chapter 18 that unites all believers. Explore foundational truths about God, creation, and humanity.

questions.question: What doctrine does Matthew 18:3 teach about salvation and entrance into the kingdom of heaven?
options: Salvation requires becoming as little children through conversion
Salvation is earned by good works and obedience
Salvation is attained through intellectual knowledge
Salvation is only for the Jewish people
questions.correctAnswer: Salvation requires becoming as little children through conversion
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:3 states, 'Except ye be converted, and become as little children, ye shall not enter into the kingdom of heaven,' teaching that salvation requires humble childlike faith and repentance.

questions.question: What doctrine about divine judgment and human responsibility does Matthew 18:6 teach?
options: It is a grievous sin to cause spiritual harm to believers, warranting severe divine judgment
All sins are equally trivial and forgiven without consequence
Only public sins are judged by God
God does not punish believers who stumble
questions.correctAnswer: It is a grievous sin to cause spiritual harm to believers, warranting severe divine judgment
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:6 teaches that offending believers, especially 'little ones,' incurs severe judgment, illustrating God's seriousness about protecting His people.

questions.question: What doctrine about church discipline and reconciliation is taught in Matthew 18:15?
options: Private correction is the first step in restoring a brother who sins
Sins should be ignored to maintain peace
Public shaming is the first step in discipline
Only church leaders can correct sin
questions.correctAnswer: Private correction is the first step in restoring a brother who sins
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:15 outlines the process of confronting a sinning brother privately as the initial phase of church discipline and reconciliation.

questions.question: Which divine attribute does Matthew 18:27 specifically demonstrate?
questions.correctAnswer: Compassion
questions.explanation: In Matthew 18:27, the lord is 'moved with compassion' and forgives the servant's debt, demonstrating God's compassion toward repentant sinners.

questions.question: Which divine attribute is especially highlighted in Matthew 18:11?
questions.correctAnswer: Salvation
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:11 states that the Son of man 'is come to save that which was lost,' emphasizing God's saving nature and mission of redemption.

questions.question: How does Matthew 18 prepare the reader for the theme of forgiveness found in the wider New Testament?
options: By instructing believers to forgive extensively and teaching the consequences of unforgiveness
By emphasizing ritual sacrifices for sin
By promoting strict legalistic adherence to the law
By focusing only on individual salvation without community implications
questions.correctAnswer: By instructing believers to forgive extensively and teaching the consequences of unforgiveness
questions.explanation: Matthew 18, especially in verses 21-35, prepares the theological foundation for New Testament teachings on forgiveness by illustrating the necessity and scope of forgiving others.

questions.question: How does the parable in Matthew 18:23-35 connect to the broader redemptive-historical theme of God's mercy in Scripture?
options: It illustrates God's mercy in forgiving immense debts and calls believers to mirror that mercy
It suggests that God’s mercy is limited to the Israelites
It teaches that mercy is only for the righteous
It emphasizes human merit over divine mercy
questions.correctAnswer: It illustrates God's mercy in forgiving immense debts and calls believers to mirror that mercy
questions.explanation: The parable in Matthew 18:23-35 echoes the Old Testament theme of God's mercy (e.g., Psalm 103) and teaches the imperative for believers to extend mercy as God has shown.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do verses Matthew 18:8 and Matthew 18:9 teach about sanctification?
options: That believers must take radical action against sin in their lives to enter eternal life
That physical mutilation is necessary for holiness
That sin is unavoidable and does not affect salvation
questions.correctAnswer: That believers must take radical action against sin in their lives to enter eternal life
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:8-9 teaches that believers must decisively remove sin-causing parts of their lives, emphasizing the seriousness of sanctification and pursuit of eternal life.

questions.question: What combined doctrine do Matthew 18:4 and Matthew 18:10 teach about humility and God's care for believers?
options: Humility as a childlike stance is essential for greatness in the kingdom, and God’s angels actively watch over believers
Humility is unnecessary if a person is strong in faith
God does not care about the humble but only the powerful
Angels only watch over the righteous elite
questions.correctAnswer: Humility as a childlike stance is essential for greatness in the kingdom, and God’s angels actively watch over believers
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:4 teaches humility like a child is key to greatness in God's kingdom, while 18:10 assures believers that heavenly angels watch over 'these little ones,' showing divine care.

questions.question: What combined doctrine about church authority and community responsibility do Matthew 18:16 and Matthew 18:17 teach?
options: That church discipline proceeds from private confrontation to involving the church community for restoration
That church discipline should be avoided at all costs
That only the individual is responsible for sin
That the state should enforce church discipline
questions.correctAnswer: That church discipline proceeds from private confrontation to involving the church community for restoration
questions.explanation: Verses 18:16-17 teach a graduated process of church discipline starting privately, then with witnesses, and finally involving the church, reflecting communal responsibility.

questions.question: Sceptics claim that Matthew 18:21-22 implies unlimited forgiveness is unrealistic and harmful. What does the passage actually teach?
options: Jesus calls for forgiving others seventy times seven, emphasizing boundless forgiveness as vital to Christian life
Jesus limits forgiveness to seven times only
Jesus teaches that forgiveness must be conditional and limited
Jesus discourages forgiveness to avoid being taken advantage of
questions.correctAnswer: Jesus calls for forgiving others seventy times seven, emphasizing boundless forgiveness as vital to Christian life
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:22 records Jesus instructing Peter to forgive not just seven times but seventy times seven, highlighting the necessity of limitless forgiveness.

questions.question: What doctrine about the unity of believers and Christ’s presence does Matthew 18:20 teach?
options: Christ is present where two or three gather in His name, affirming the spiritual unity and divine presence in the church
Christ only dwells in large congregations
Christ is absent from sinful gatherings
Christ's presence is limited to the temple in Jerusalem
questions.correctAnswer: Christ is present where two or three gather in His name, affirming the spiritual unity and divine presence in the church
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:20 assures believers that Jesus is spiritually present whenever even a small group gathers in His name, emphasizing the unity and presence of Christ in the church.

questions.question: What doctrine about God's covenant faithfulness and the binding authority of the church is taught in Matthew 18:18?
options: The church’s binding and loosing on earth is ratified in heaven, demonstrating divine covenant authority
Church decisions have no spiritual authority
Only individual believers have authority, not the church
Binding and loosing refer only to legal contracts
questions.correctAnswer: The church’s binding and loosing on earth is ratified in heaven, demonstrating divine covenant authority
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:18 teaches that what the church binds or looses on earth is confirmed in heaven, showing God’s covenant faithfulness and delegated authority to the church.

questions.question: What doctrine concerning human sinfulness and divine mercy is taught in Matthew 18:24-27?
options: Human sin incurs an unpayable debt, but God’s mercy can forgive completely
Human sin can always be fully repaid by works
God refuses to forgive serious debts
questions.correctAnswer: Human sin incurs an unpayable debt, but God’s mercy can forgive completely
questions.explanation: The servant’s great debt in Matthew 18:24-27 symbolizes human sinfulness, and the lord’s forgiveness shows God’s complete mercy despite this debt.

questions.question: What doctrine about the consequences of unforgiveness is taught in Matthew 18:34-35?
options: God will punish those who do not forgive others from their hearts
Only God can forgive, so human forgiveness is unnecessary
Forgiveness is optional in the Christian life
questions.correctAnswer: God will punish those who do not forgive others from their hearts
questions.explanation: Matthew 18:34-35 states that the lord delivers the unforgiving servant to tormentors, teaching that God requires heartfelt forgiveness or there will be judgment.
